dct_title_s: Study of population changes in the city of Minneapolis, 1920 to 1930
dct_alternative_sm: Study of population changes in the city of Minneapolis, 1920 to 1930
dct_description_sm: "Prepared by City Planning Commission. Minneapolis Minnesota. H. E. Olson -- Engr. February 1934."; "Areas outlined on map show decrease in population 1920-1930. Figures show percentage decrease in general area of figure."; 3rd Ward is outlined on the map; no other wards are indicated.; Includes figures: area of city; area occupied by housing; population in 1920 and 1930; and population mobility = total increase, decrease in central areas, and increase in outer districts.; "B-3 / A-85"--At lower right corner. Also appears upside-down and backwards at upper and lower left corners.; "Bindery Edge" is printed in right margin.; "1400 / 313"--Marked in pencil at upper left and lower right corners of recto and verso.
60 x 37 centimeters, on sheet 62 x 45 centimeters
